summary: Side-view digging and upgrade loop in Godot 4: mine ore, watch the fuel, sell, upgrade the rig, reach the core at 250 m. Turkish UI.
key_features: Dig-sell-upgrade loop across five underground layers down to the core at 250 m
Fuel is the timer: every descent is a bet on getting back up before it runs out
Seeded worlds - a daily world and a Deep Mode built from the same seed code
Earthquakes, exploration fog and depth ambience that change how the layers read
